title: Module 5 Current — History Comparison (historical / Influx)
description:
Legacy alias — prefer `panel-module5-randomforest-ml-influx.json` for new panels.

30-day RandomForest bands for dates **before Prometheus scrape** (~35d from scrape start). Live **History Comparison** uses PromQL (`machine_metrics`, `last_over_time(machine_metric_*[6m])`); older ranges need Influx `ml_predictions` from backfill.

Use the **dashboard** time picker only — do not set panel-level timeFrom/timeTo.

| Target | Source |
|--------|--------|
| A Actual | Influx `r.machine` + `r._field` |
| B–D ML bands | Influx `ml_predictions` (`upper`, `lower`, `expected`) |

Datasource: same Influx/Flux UID as your working peer-band panel.

targets.query:
from(bucket: v.bucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r.machine == "2406-176021" and
    r._field == "Module5_Current_A"
  )
  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "Module 5 (Actual)")

from(bucket: v.bucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ml_predictions")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.machine == "2406-176021" and r.field == "Module5_Current_A")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "upper")
  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 5m, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> fill(usePrevious: true)
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "Upper Bound")

from(bucket: v.bucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ml_predictions")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.machine == "2406-176021" and r.field == "Module5_Current_A")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "lower")
  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 5m, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> fill(usePrevious: true)
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "Lower Bound")

from(bucket: v.bucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ml_predictions")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.machine == "2406-176021" and r.field == "Module5_Current_A")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "expected")
  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 5m, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> fill(usePrevious: true)
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "Expected (ML)")
